first_impression.reaction: Okay, the first paragraph actually answers me: legal there or symbolic, and watch hurricane season. Good. The second paragraph about photographs and glassy water I just thumbed past. Key Takeaways are right there and they're useful, so I stayed. I read those, the FAQ and skimmed the weather bit. I didn't read the paperwork section properly on the train, it's long.

journey.quote: A Punta Cana destination wedding can be legally binding if you follow the Dominican civil process, or you can marry legally in Australia first and hold a symbolic ceremony on the sand.
journey.reaction: Direct answer in the first line. This is what I want from a Google result.

journey.quote: Punta Cana tends to arrive on the shortlist through a photograph: white chairs, pale sand, water the colour of glass.
journey.reaction: Pretty, but it's the bit I scroll past. It sits between the answer and the takeaways.

journey.quote: February and March are the drier months, while the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.
journey.reaction: Specific dates, exactly what I'd screenshot. Nice.

journey.quote: Ask any resort about other weddings that day, beach ceremony rules, shade, access and a covered wet weather option before you sign.
journey.reaction: Useful checklist I wouldn't have thought of. Nothing in the takeaways about cost or guest safety though, and those are my next two questions.

journey.section: When to plan a Punta Cana wedding
journey.quote: They are averages for the 30 years from 1961 to 1990, and a rain day is a day with at least 1 mm of rain.
journey.reaction: Is this still true in 2026? 1961 to 1990 sounds old. I appreciate they say where it's from instead of hiding it, but it made me pause.

journey.section: Getting your guests to Punta Cana from Australia
journey.quote: For guests in Sydney, Melbourne or Perth, this is a long journey, and the earlier they know, the more choice they have.
journey.reaction: Very Australia-focused. I'm in Singapore, so the travel advice section is less about me. Fine, I just skipped it.

journey.section: Getting your guests to Punta Cana from Australia
journey.quote: As at November 2026, [Smartraveller's advice for the Dominican Republic](https://www.smartraveller.gov.au/destinations/americas/dominican-republic) is to exercise a high degree of caution, due to the threat of violent crime.
journey.reaction: Dated and honest. I trust a page more when it tells me the uncomfortable bit. But this is buried way down, I nearly missed it.

journey.quote: Resort wedding offers differ in what they include, from ceremony set-up to the number of events and guests covered.
journey.reaction: This is where I hoped to find cost. It dodges it without saying it's dodging it. Just tell me how much, or tell me straight that you can't.

journey.quote: As at November 2026; this is general information, not legal advice.
journey.reaction: Good, dated. The FAQ headings match what I'd type into Google.
